messages:
olivia: Attempted a prod push for v1.14.3 to fix the kv-cache leak, but deploy-bot blocked me with elevation required.

olivia: `deploy start --env prod --version v1.14.3`

deploy-bot: ERROR 403: permission denied. Missing role: `prod-deployer`. You can request a JIT elevation or ping oncall. Ref: job-6821

samir: @eng-oncall can we JIT olivia? This is the INC hotfix.

eng-oncall: Before we elevate, what's the rollback play? Need a verified rollback command and expected downtime.

olivia: Rollback tested in staging: 
```
deploy rollback --env prod --to-version v1.14.2 --force
```
Tested canary -> 10% -> 100% in staging; observed health probe recovery in ~90s. Estimate rollback 3-5m.

anya: Quick deploy checklist: 1) pin container tag, 2) disable HPA/autoscaler for 10m during rollout, 3) snapshot perf metrics and traces. Did you pin the image?

olivia: Yes pinned to `redwood/model-serving:2026.03.18-v3`. K8s rollout will be paused awaiting canary success. Autoscaler disabled for 12m.

kevin: @samir +1 for granting but must include audit note & incident link in request. Also prefer 30m limited window.

samir: INC-1452. Owner: samir. Summary: memory leak in kv-cache causing OOMs on 2/8 pods; mitigated via temp mem cap.

eng-oncall: Ok granting 30m JIT. Audit reason required in grant and revoke when done.

deploy-bot: ACTION: granted temporary role `prod-deployer` to olivia for 00:30:00. AuditID=AU-22091. Logged to audit.kms.redwood:/audits/AU-22091

olivia: Kicking off deploy now. Posting canary logs once available.

deploy-bot: job-6821 started by olivia. CI logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/6821 (streaming)

olivia: Canary at 10% -> health checks good, cpu/mem stable, p50/p95 latency within SLA. Promoting.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed. v1.14.3 is now live in prod. job-6821 TraceID=tr-0a9f

kevin: Nice work. Reminder: drop the JIT role when finished. Also add a short release note.

olivia: Revoking now.

deploy-bot: ACTION: revoked `prod-deployer` from olivia. AuditID=AU-22091. Revocation logged. :lock: 

anya: Please add a brief release note in #release-notes and update the runbook with the rollback snippet + INC-1452 link.

olivia: Done — posted summary in #release-notes and updated runbook (runbook v2.3) with rollback command and incident tag.

samir: Filing a follow-up to automate canary gating -> oncall escalation if health not recovered (reduce manual steps).

kevin: Created RFC: /rfc/deploy-jit-workflow assigned to eng-runtime. Will include JIT UX, audit retention, and automated rollback gating.

olivia: Thanks all — monitoring for the next hour, will reopen if anything odd shows up.
